import json, os
import psycopg

job='bcba0db7-3f46-4748-a0e2-a9b6e4c24d6b'
item='AMLP_E_2001X13'
url=os.getenv('APP_DB_URL','').strip()
with psycopg.connect(url) as conn:
  with conn.cursor() as cur:
    cur.execute("""
      select created_at, provider, operation, endpoint, status_code,
             coalesce(job_id,''), coalesce(item_key,''), coalesce(error_text,''), coalesce(details_json,'')
      from external_api_errors
      where coalesce(job_id,'')=%s or coalesce(item_key,'')=%s
      order by created_at desc
      limit 20
    """, (job, item))
    rows=[]
    for r in cur.fetchall():
      rows.append({'created_at':r[0],'provider':r[1],'operation':r[2],'endpoint':r[3],'status_code':r[4],'job_id':r[5],'item_key':r[6],'error_text':r[7],'details_json':r[8]})
    print('EXTERNAL_ERRORS_BY_JOB_ITEM', json.dumps(rows))
print('EXTERNAL_ERRORS_DONE')
